artifact_observations.reasoning: The people in the foreground exhibit extreme motion blur or intentional obfuscation. While this may be a photographic artifact (long exposure/movement) rather than AI generation failure, it represents a significant structural degradation of the subjects. In AI contexts, this often mimics 'melting' or failure to resolve fine details.

The texture of the rock face is somewhat uniform and lacks high-frequency detail in certain areas, appearing slightly 'painted' or smoothed compared to the sharpness of the vegetation. This is subtle but characteristic of generative smoothing.
